tasks.short: Prepare and implement remedial programs for students requiring extra help.

steps.what: Review actual adult learner work and identify specific remedial teaching needs
inputs: actual learner work and prior teaching observations
outputs: teacher-identified remedial objectives and learner context

steps.what: Assemble candidate remedial exercises from approved resources using native objective filters
inputs: teacher-identified remedial objectives and learner context

steps.what: Adapt exercises and choose the actual remedial program for each learner
inputs: teacher-identified remedial objectives and learner context

steps.what: Implement remedial instruction and observe the learner response
Write and approve the actual remedial progress note and next teaching adjustments
Save the approved final remedial progress note

tasks.design: Configure {LMS} objective filters over approved remedial resources. The instructor identifies needs, checks candidates and adapts the program. Actual remedial instruction precedes the actual progress note and its separately gated save. No model diagnoses learning needs or evaluates outcomes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitable existing remedial exercises may require repeated manual catalogue searches.
tasks.enabler_now: Native resource tags and filters can reuse approved teaching objectives.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing language barriers, confidence, missing knowledge and support needs.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor responds to the learner and changes teaching accordingly.
tasks.altitude: More time available for individual remedial instruction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: learning platforms can filter tagged resources; this remedial catalogue configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares and remaining effort are provisional. Observe residual search after existing LMS filters; existing search and recommendation functions earn no benefit.

Actual curriculum owners supply resource_id, approved_objective and level tags. s1 captures the instructor actual need at full time; s2 retains 7.5 hours to verify resource suitability. Missing tags use manual search.
Teaching and progress capture remain full effort. The final note exists before its save; changed notes require renewed approval. Same-system saves earn no benefit.
research_questions: Which exercise searches remain manual after existing LMS filters?

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete final actual remedial progress note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only search changes: 15 times 50% = 7.5 hours less 1 upkeep = 6.5. Low halves that benefit: 3.75 less 1 = 2.75.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare classes and show written evidence of preparation to supervisors.

steps.what: Review assigned class objectives, actual learner needs and previous lesson outcomes
Assemble the preparation evidence pack using native lesson and resource templates
inputs: actual teacher lesson files and approved resources

steps.what: Prepare the actual teaching sequence, examples and equipment for the assigned class
Write and approve final written preparation evidence and the requesting supervisor recipient
outputs: approved final written preparation evidence and exact supervisor

steps.what: Show the approved final written preparation evidence to the requesting immediate supervisor
inputs: approved final written preparation evidence and exact supervisor

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} and {DOCS} preparation templates to assemble existing lesson objectives, resource links and class details. The instructor completes actual teaching preparation, writes evidence of work actually done and approves the final version before separately showing it to the supervisor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Written evidence may require repeated copying of already established lesson details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native lesson templates and document fields can reuse exact class and resource data.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing whether the class preparation fits the actual adult learners.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor anticipates misconceptions and prepares useful examples.
tasks.altitude: Clear written evidence of actual class preparation with less repeated assembly.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: lesson and document templates can reuse exact preparation fields; this integration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual copy and assembly after existing lesson templates. Existing automatic fields earn no saving.

s1 captures actual class_id, objectives and learner context. Actual lesson files supply resource links. s2 retains 15 hours for selection, missing fields and pack checking; missing source data uses manual assembly.
s4 writes final evidence after preparation actually occurs and includes the actual requesting supervisor. Showing remains full effort; changed evidence requires renewed approval.
research_questions: Which preparation fields still require repeated manual assembly?

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final preparation evidence and exact supervisor

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only pack assembly changes: 30 times 50% = 15 hours less 1 upkeep = 14. Low halves that benefit: 7.5 less 1 = 6.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Enforce administration policies and rules governing students.

steps.what: Retrieve applicable current student rules and actual case history using native policy links
outputs: instructor-checked applicable rule text and case context

steps.what: Establish facts and enforce student policies through fair human judgement and conversation
inputs: instructor-checked applicable rule text and case context
outputs: actual enforcement decision and conversation outcome

steps.what: Write and approve the final actual incident record and student notice
inputs: actual enforcement decision and conversation outcome
outputs: approved final incident record and student notice with exact recipient

steps.what: Save the approved actual incident record
inputs: approved final incident record and student notice with exact recipient

steps.what: Deliver the approved final policy notice to its approved student recipient
inputs: approved final incident record and student notice with exact recipient

tasks.design: Configure current rule links and version labels in {LMS}. The instructor establishes facts, hears the learner and applies the authorised policy. A separate actual incident record and final written notice are approved before their separate save and student delivery. No student scoring, monitoring or automated sanction is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applicable rule versions may require repeated manual retrieval.
tasks.enabler_now: Native versioned policy links can expose the current approved rule alongside case context.
tasks.still_hard: Fairness, proportionality, incomplete facts and authority to impose a consequence.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor understands context and protects an adult learner opportunity to explain.
tasks.altitude: Human policy enforcement with current rules and explicit actual records.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: learning platforms can expose versioned policy links; this retrieval configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual rule retrieval after current policy pages; current search and case fields earn no benefit.
Actual policy owners supply policy_id, version and effective scope. s1 retains 9 hours for applicability and case checking; absent current text requires manual verification.

s2 retains full enforcement work. s3 captures actual facts and writes complete final notices; action beyond instructor authority waits for authorised review. Each changed record or notice is approved again. Same-system saves earn no benefit.
research_questions: Which current rule searches remain manual during actual student incidents?

incremental.description: Maintain current policy links and scope labels

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final actual incident record
s3 complete final student notice and exact student recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only rule retrieval changes: 15 times 40% = 6 hours less 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Low halves that benefit: 3 less 0.5 = 2.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Use computers and audiovisual equipment to supplement presentations.

steps.what: Choose appropriate computer and audiovisual materials for the actual presentation objectives
outputs: teacher-selected presentation materials and equipment requirements

steps.what: Check presentation files, media links and captions using native lesson readiness settings
inputs: teacher-selected presentation materials and equipment requirements

steps.what: Set up and physically test the computer, display, sound and presentation equipment
outputs: actual equipment readiness and fallback materials

steps.what: Use computers and audiovisual aids during actual teaching and adapt to learner responses
inputs: actual equipment readiness and fallback materials
outputs: actual presentation delivery and equipment observations

steps.what: Write and approve actual equipment and presentation improvement notes
inputs: actual presentation delivery and equipment observations

steps.what: Save the approved final presentation notes

tasks.design: Use native {LMS} and {DOCS} readiness templates for actual media paths, caption tracks and presentation packages. OTHER denotes classroom computer and audiovisual equipment. The instructor checks content accessibility, physically tests equipment and teaches. Actual delivery notes and their gated save remain separate full-effort work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Presentation readiness may require repeatedly locating and checking separate media files.
tasks.enabler_now: Native package and readiness settings can reuse actual file paths and media requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Equipment faults and adapting audiovisual teaching to adult learner needs.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor notices whether a visual or audio example is helping.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated media preparation before human audiovisual teaching.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: presentation tools have native media packaging and caption settings; this readiness configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Observe residual manual file checks after existing presentation tools. Existing playback and automatic captions earn no new saving.

s1 selects actual file_path, media_type, caption_track and teaching objective. s2 retains 12 hours for content, accessibility and playback checking; missing compatible media uses manual preparation. No invented caption accuracy baseline is used.
Physical setup, delivery and actual note writing remain full effort. Final note approval precedes its save, which earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which repeated media readiness checks remain after current presentation packaging?

incremental.description: Maintain actual classroom media readiness settings

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete final actual presentation notes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only readiness preparation changes: 20 times 40% = 8 hours less 0.5 upkeep = 7.5. Low halves that benefit: 4 less 0.5 = 3.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Human adult instruction with easier resource and preparation evidence retrieval.
reach: Learner assessment and teaching decisions remain with instructors.
role.ambitious_version: Responsive adult education with less repeated preparation administration and complete actual records.

job.title: Adult Basic Education, Adult Secondary Education, and English as a Second Language Instructors
